context.content_translation:
Bescura Cars 的市场营销团队创作了一系列-------幽默的广告，旨在吸引您的消费者。
A. economically
B. exactly
C. deliberately
D. patiently

items.question: The marketing team at Bescura Cars he created a series of ------- humorous commercials, designed to appeal to your consumers.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“deliberately”代入题干后为“The marketing team at Bescura Cars he created a series of deliberately humorous commercials, designed to appeal to your consumers.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：C（deliberately）。
items.evidence: 参考原文第 1 段：The marketing team at Bescura Cars he created a series of ------- humorous commercials, designed to appeal to your consumers.
